meta.interpretation: Descriptive monitoring update. Legacy Gaussian models and independent-sample tests are exploratory, not validated repeated-measures inference. No causal, seasonal, or nursery-function conclusions.
meta.taxon_note: Positive-catch taxon codes, including unresolved identifications; not a count of confirmed biological species.

seasonality.interpretation: Sampling-calendar summary only. Unequal annual survey timing cannot establish seasonal abundance patterns. CPUE denominator is unique location/section/haul events.

guilds.interpretation: Provisional classifications for a subset of taxa; proportions exclude unassigned taxa and are not proportions of all fish.

nursery.reason: Species identity is not juvenile size or age; these data cannot estimate nursery function.
